meta.name: agentic-tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development for behaviour a unit test cannot reach, by writing the expectation against the running app before writing the code. Declare the consequence first, watch it fail, implement, watch it pass. Use when building a user-facing feature, when the user asks for TDD on UI or full-stack work, when a unit test cannot express the outcome that matters, or when you want a red-green loop that runs against the real app instead of mocks.

copy.tagline: 先写下想看到的结果并让它失败,再改代码直到真实应用里通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果单元测试说不清某个功能算不算做好,想直接对着真实应用来验证
copy.tagline_en: Write down the outcome you expect, watch it fail, then code until the real app passes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a unit test can't capture what done looks like and you'd rather verify against the real app

howto.what: Claude 会先写明 App 必须做到的结果(比如点击后发出某个请求、出现某个元素),跑一次看着它失败,再写实现让同一次调用通过,然后自由重构,并把这个流程存成可重复运行的回归检查。
howto.when: 当你做面向用户的功能、要求对 UI 或全栈代码用 TDD、或单元测试无法表达真正在意的结果时触发。它针对真实运行中的 App,而不是 mock。

say.text: 用 TDD 做这个部署按钮:先写它该发出的请求和该显示的提示,看它失败,再实现
say.note: 会先跑期望,拿到红的结果

say.text: 把刚才这条部署流程保存下来,以后每次改动都重跑验证
say.note: 存成一个可整体复验的 flow

say.text: 重新断言一次这个状态,不要重复点击
say.note: 改用 reticle_assert,不重放副作用

howto.what_en: Claude writes what the app must do (a request, a signal, an element), runs it to watch it fail, implements until the same call passes, then refactors freely and saves the journey as a re-runnable flow.
howto.when_en: Use when building a user-facing feature, when you ask for TDD on UI or full-stack work, or when a unit test cannot express the outcome that matters. It runs against the real app, not mocks.

say_en.text: TDD the deploy button: declare what it should fire, watch it fail, implement.
say_en.note: the expectation runs first, giving a red verdict

say_en.text: Save the deploy journey I just ran so every change re-runs it as a check.
say_en.note: saves a flow you can verify later

say_en.text: Re-assert that state instead of clicking again, so no side effect repeats.
